newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips end firmer after seesaw session. [CORRECTED 22:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips end firmer after seesaw session. [CORRECTED 22:30 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects throughout to make clear that Dow did not fall but rose.)
Blue-chip stocks closed firmer Tuesday as the market advanced again after a zig-zag session.

Based on early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average gained 22.75 points to close at 7,312.15. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a 14-10 margin on active volume of about 530 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Nasdaq composite index fell 19.88 points to 1,384.91.
